split_contract: All entity IDs must be disjoint across train, development, and test. Test queries and references may not be used for training, threshold selection, epoch selection, or feature normalization.
negative_contract: Within each split, pair every query with every other split target to create explicit NONE episodes. Correct-target candidates outside the frozen functional portal region are same-image hard negatives.
claim_boundary: Curated public-image Development and algorithm-fresh-by-PB1 confirmation only. No public-access, traversability, executed motion, navigation, arrival, user-benefit, or safety claim.
